Title: Submission - Billboard #1 (Melpominee action that provides stealth)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Billboard #1
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Melpominee
+1 stealth action.
Gain 1 pool.
[mel] Put this card on this acting vampire and burn all other copies of Billboard #1 in play. Vampires with Melpominee [mel] have +1 stealth. If this vampire goes to torpor, you burn 3 pool. You may burn this card during any Methuselah's untap phase.
[MEL] As [mel] above, and you gain 1 pool.

Art notes: A night-watchman with earphones sitting on his chair near a cc-tv he doesn't watch. He's busy playing air guitar and mimicking a song on his chair while a Daughter is infiltrating.

World of Darkness reference: You can basically listen to music everywhere, even at work (hum) which can be distracting. And if you're a business man (), you may gain resources by sponsoring the right artist.
Game references: Art Scam, Hidden Pathways

How does this card address a compelling game need? Daughters don't intercept and tend to lack stealth. Giving them a new stealth card (that uses an action so the powerlevel is still in line with their current card) can be useful.
The main problem with this card is that if you have stealth problem, you won't probably be able to make it succeed. On the other hand, it starts at 1 stealth and you may use all your stealth and block denial on this action to help you for later.

Created by: Ankha

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body:
I disagree that DoC need any more stealth. They already have MEL stealth card and their own stealth location and an 'unblockable action' card and an unconditional block fail. Also, most of their actions (politics, choir actions...) are already on +1 stealth and g5-6 have access to OBF and they can use Creepshow Casino.

They may lack lots of stuff, but imho stealth isn't one of them.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Well, it's interesting to see that non-gr2 daughter are supposed to be presence weenie, but it does diverge a lot from the proposed card.

As far as I am concerned, daughter don't seem to lack stealth at all. They lack way to survive, which is linked to the relative difficulty to pass your vote, which itself tend to be linked to the fact that their voting power is extremely lacking when people routinely bring Inner Circle on the table.

The two option here would be either to give them non-vote related survival option, or give them something which allow them not to be FUBAR when the third inner circle hit the table.

(well, of course they have shattering crescendo as defence. But I believe Shattering Crescendo is not very Daughter-like, and if you don't center your deck on it, it won't help too much)
